# @dxtmisha/wiki

> Storybook documentation toolkit, component metadata registry, and MDX documentation system for DXT UI.

Centralizes component metadata, prop categories, Storybook argTypes builders (`WikiStorybook`), React documentation components (`StorybookMain`, `StorybookDescriptions`), prop presets, and bilingual MDX documentation (English/Russian).

## Key Classes & Modules

- [WikiStorybook](src/classes/WikiStorybook.ts): Builder class generating Storybook-compatible `argTypes` maps from component properties and presets.
- [WikiStorybookItem](src/classes/WikiStorybookItem.ts): Represents individual prop metadata, categories (`Status`, `Values`, `Styles`, `Adaptive`, `Technical`, `Hook`), and control configurations.
- [WikiStorybookProp](src/classes/WikiStorybookProp.ts): Property-level handler configuring description, default values, controls, and category bindings.
- [StorybookMain / StorybookDescriptions](src/documentation/storybook/StorybookMain.tsx): Pre-built React components for rendering standard Storybook component documentation layouts and description panels.
- [wiki prop presets](src/media/props/wiki.ts) (`@dxtmisha/wiki/media`): Centralized Storybook control presets (`wikiStatus`, `wikiValue`, `wikiStyle`, `wikiButton`, `wikiField`, `wikiIconInclude`, `wikiOption`, etc.).
- [wikiDescriptions](src/media/descriptions/wikiDescriptions.ts) (`@dxtmisha/wiki/media`): Central registry of component descriptions, metadata, headers, argTypes, and layouts for 80+ design system components.
- [MDX documentation](src/media/mdx): Structured bilingual Markdown/MDX documentation files for components, properties, events, slots, and exposed methods.
- [functional MDX](src/media/functional) (`@dxtmisha/wiki/functional/*`): MDX documentation for isomorphic utility functions and framework modules.

## Subpath Exports

- `@dxtmisha/wiki` (`.`): Core classes (`WikiStorybook`, `WikiStorybookItem`, `WikiStorybookProp`) and Storybook types.
- `@dxtmisha/wiki/storybook`: React components (`StorybookMain`, `StorybookDescriptions`).
- `@dxtmisha/wiki/media`: Sample media assets, prop control presets, and component descriptions registry.
- `@dxtmisha/wiki/functional/*`: Direct access to functional MDX documentation files.
- `@dxtmisha/wiki/storybook/styles`: Base SCSS styles for Storybook documentation pages.
